title: CPC-2025-2081-DB-VHCA
text:
CPC-2025-2081-DB-VHCA  Council District: 14 – Jurado
  CEQA: ENV-2025-2082-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-26-26
  Plan Area: Northeast Los Angeles

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed August 14, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  4127 East Supreme Court
  (4127 – 4129 East Supreme Court; 4127 – 4129 North Mission Road)

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition of the existing billboard structure on a 4,500-square-foot lot and the construction, use, and
  maintenance of a new, six-story 13-unit apartment building with two units reserved for Very Low-Income
  Households. The Project will include 13 one-bedroom units which will range from 532 square feet to 562 square
  feet. The building will have 9,499 square feet of floor area and a maximum building height of 78 feet. The
  Project will provide 1,105 square feet of open space consisting of a community room and rooftop open space.

  The Project is eliminating required automobile parking spaces pursuant to California Government Code Section
  65863.2 (AB 2097) and will provide 11 automobile parking spaces on the ground floor and a total of 17 bicycle
  parking spaces (15 long-term and two short-term). The Project also proposes to provide six new trees and to
  import approximately 215 cubic yards of earth materials.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Article 19, Section 15332 (Class 32),
  an exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.22 A.25(g) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Density Bonus
  for a Housing Development Project consisting of a new six-story, 13-unit apartment building with two units
  reserved for Very Low-Income households, and requesting the following Off-Menu Incentives and Waivers
  of Development Standards:
  a. An Off-Menu Incentive for a 5.6 percent reduced rear yard setback of 17 feet in lieu of the 18 feet
  required per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.14 C.2;
  b. An Off-Menu Incentive for a 15.0 percent reduced open space of 1,105 square feet in lieu of the 1,300
  square feet required per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 G.2;
  c. An Off-Menu Incentive for a 100 percent reduced north side yard setback of zero feet in lieu of the
  required nine feet per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.14 C.2;
  d. An Off-Menu Incentive for relief from Ordinance 173,070 (Subarea 7075A) to permit 100 percent
  residential development in lieu of prohibiting 100 percent residential development;
  e. A Waiver of Development Standards to permit a zero-foot south side yard setback in lieu of the
  required nine feet per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.14 C.2;
  f. A Waiver of Development Standards to permit zero-foot landscaped setbacks in lieu of the required
  five-foot landscaped setbacks (Commercial Corner Development) per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.22
  A.23(a)(10)(i);

  g. A Waiver of Development Standards to permit a maximum building height of 78 feet, in lieu of a
  maximum of 25 feet and 33 feet (Transitional Height) as required per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21.1
  A.10;
  h. A Waiver of Development Standards to permit a maximum building height of 78 feet, in lieu of a
  maximum of 45 feet (Commercial Corner Development) as required per LAMC Chapter 1 Section
  12.22 A.23(a)(1); and
  i. A Waiver of Development Standards to permit a 41.4 percent increase in the Floor Area Ratio (FAR)
  to allow 2.12:1 in lieu of the 1.5:1 permitted in a commercial zone in Height District 1 per LAMC Chapter
  1 Section 12.21.1 A.1.

  Applicant:  Brett Boston, Parkman Apartments, LLC
  Representative: Gary Benjamin, Alchemy Planning + Land Use

  Staff:  Linda Lou, City Planner
  linda.lou@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1473
summary: Demolition of billboard and construction of a six-story, 13-unit apartment building at 4127 East Supreme Court with two very low-income units and communal open space.
